newsitem.title: KENYA: 16 suspects charged over Kenya coast violence.
newsitem.headline: 16 suspects charged over Kenya coast violence.

text.p: Sixteen suspects were charged in a Mombasa court on Monday with possession of offensive weapons after five days of violence on Kenya's Indian Ocean coast.
All pleaded not guilty and Mombasa Chief Magistrate Aggrey Muchelule said he would rule on Tuesday on whether to grant bail, which was opposed by Police Prosecutor Gideon Kimilu.
"If the accused are released on bond when the situation is still volatile, they are likely to continue with the same offences," Kimilu told the Mombasa court.
"Investigations are ongoing and we are likely to prefer more serious charges," he added.
None of the 16, all from the coast area, were represented by lawyers. They were all in tattered clothes. One had a head wound and another a bandaged arm.

One of the accused said he was arrested with two brothers as they were repairing fishing nets. Another said he had three arrows and a bow in his home but the weapons had been part of his family's heritage for generations.
